question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is: **disappear.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence structure indicates a simple present tense is needed to describe an action that happens regularly or universally.
 
• **"Disappear"** is the simple present form of the verb that fits seamlessly into the sentence.
 
• The phrase **"begins to" **already implies the onset of an action, so the following verb should be in the base form, which is "disappear."

Therefore, the correction answer is : disappear

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Being disappeared" **is not grammatically correct in this context.
 
• **"Have disappeared"** is in the present perfect tense and would not be used after "begins to."
 
• **"Having disappeared" **would suggest that the action of disappearing has already been completed, which does not fit the context of something beginning to happen.
